description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs validate_path(): when the last chain cert is self-issued (issuer==subject), the code additionally checks that the anchor SPKI matches the cert SPKI. Without this check, an attacker who creates a CA with the same DN as a trusted root but a different key could have the name match succeed (since chain_walk is skipped until after anchor selection), then fail in chain_walk — but it leaks timing. The guard short-circuits early and prevents even attempting chain_walk with the wrong SPKI. This is a meaningful defense-in-depth check that a contributor might remove as 'redundant with the signature check in chain_walk' — it is not redundant.
title: Self-issued SPKI guard in validate_path prevents key-collision attack
